title: Agents unlock new capabilities through Switching LoRA Adapters as a Tool (SLAaaT)
abstract: arXiv:2608.17034v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Post-training can unlock new capabilities and improve performance on specialized tasks, but sometimes at the cost of catastrophic forgetting in other domains. This poses a problem in long agent trajectories that compose different capabilities. We reject this tradeoff by giving an agent a tool to switch between specialized LoRA adapters mid-trace. To test its effectiveness, we compose two synthetic coding tasks that are logically simple but require specialization. We find that this allows the model to solve problems it previously could not, that the model is able to switch autonomously (and find a new strategy that beats our human heuristic baseline on one task), and that this incurs an up to an 18x reduction in capability tax compared to an agent using only one specialized adapter. Our approach also substantially outperforms spawning subagents in both task capabilities and token usage.

translated_title: 代理通过切换LoRA适配器作为工具（SLAaaT）解锁新能力
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17034v1 公告类型：新 摘要：后训练可以解锁新能力并提升专业任务性能，但有时会以其他领域的灾难性遗忘为代价。这在组合不同能力的长期代理轨迹中构成问题。我们通过赋予代理在轨迹中途切换专门LoRA适配器的工具来拒绝这种权衡。为了测试其有效性，我们组合了两个逻辑简单但需要专业化的合成编码任务。我们发现这使模型能够解决之前无法解决的问题，模型能够自主切换（并在一个任务上找到一种击败我们人工启发式基线的新策略），且与仅使用一个专门适配器的代理相比，能力税最多减少18倍。我们的方法在任务能力和令牌使用上也显著优于生成子代理。
tldr: 本文提出一种通过让代理在任务执行中自主切换专门LoRA适配器的方法，显著提升多任务能力并减少灾难性遗忘，在合成编码任务上实现高达18倍的能力税降低。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a method enabling agents to autonomously switch specialized LoRA adapters mid-task, significantly enhancing multi-task capabilities and reducing catastrophic forgetting, achieving up to an 18x reduction in capability tax on synthetic coding tasks.
